row: hospice death during the storm, care never interrupted
account: My dad had stage 4 lung cancer and had been on home hospice since December. During the February winter storm our power and heat stayed on the whole time and the hospice nurse came every day. He died peacefully at home on 2021-02-16, the way the nurse said he would. They lived in Harris County, TX.

account: My brother was killed in a car crash on 2021-02-25 on a dry highway, after the ice from the winter storm had melted. The other driver was drunk. They lived in Travis County, TX.

account: My wife had heart disease for ten years. On 2021-02-16, during the winter storm, she had a heart attack while watching TV in our warm house. We never lost power. They lived in Tarrant County, TX.

account: My grandmother had advanced dementia and lived in a nursing home with a full generator; the air conditioning never went off during Hurricane Irma. She died in her sleep on 2017-09-20. They lived in Collier County, FL.
